alt.en: A large gray gavel on its block sits between a stack of papers on the left and a gray server on the right. Orange lines connect the papers to the gavel and the gavel to the server.
alt.zh: 一把大型灰色法槌置于中央，左侧是一叠纸，右侧是一台灰色服务器。橙色线条将纸张、法槌和服务器依次连接起来。

caption.en: Illustration: Papers, a gavel and a server represent an audit of contract inference repair decisions; the diagram does not depict a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：纸张、法槌与服务器代表对合同推理答案修复决策的审计；本图不描绘经过测试的部署。
